Sound timing scenario still needs deterministic UI telemetry to assert exactly one result sound at transition end.
rca of the issue: The apparent extra sound event in one run came from instrumenting all media.play calls, which includes click.mp3. Without a dedicated result-sound hook/event, browser-level instrumentation can misattribute click and result sounds, causing flaky assertions for ONCE-at-stop behavior.
